# 00000005546

**English.** Definition: Induced D-modules are the module structures generated by highest-weight standard objects. Conjecture: The weight-two classification depends only on the flag length and is complete in the derived category, and the classification preserves central characters. (flag-length weight-two classification of induced modules)

**中文。** 定义：诱导型 D-模指由最高权标准对象生成的模结构。猜想：权二情形的分类恒仅依赖旗长度且在复形范畴下完全；分类过程保持中心特征不变。（诱导旗长度权二分类）
